scripts.dev: echo Iniciando backend... && start cmd /k "cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001" && timeout /t 3 && echo Iniciando frontend... && start cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev-simple: echo 'Abre 2 terminales y ejecuta:' && echo 'Terminal 1: npm run backend' && echo 'Terminal 2: npm run frontend'
scripts.install-all: npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend
